newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan sending aid flights to Iran and Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Jordan sending aid flights to Iran and Sudan.

text.p: Jordan sent a planeload of relief aid to Iran on Thursday to help tens of thousands of people made homeless by an earthquake last week, the official Petra news agency said.

It said Jordan sent 18 tonnes of tents, blankets and medicine to Iran, where relief workers have resettled 36,000 people whose homes were destroyed in the snow-swept mountains in the north-west of the country.

The agency quoted Minister of Religious Affairs Abdul Salam al-Abbadi as saying King Hussein had ordered that the aid be sent to Iran as part of Jordan's efforts to "support the Islamic community and strengthen ties with Moslem countries."
Nearly 1,000 people were killed and 2,600 injured in the quake, which disrupted the lives of 60,000 people.
Petra said a relief plane would also be sent to Sudan on Sunday with humanitarian aid to help people affected by fighting in the south.
